about: The reported conflict: the writer proposes a pure-number identity and the critic flags it. Before the quality bar the parse kept it (the note lands on a just-filled field); the self-check now drops it, and the critic's note is on the still-empty identity.

description.value: A brass charm that drinks the heat of Low Sky thermals and gives it back as lift.

change.value: Each jump inside a rising thermal carries you one island higher.
change.note: ties it to the band's air

tradeoff.value: In still air it cools and weighs you down.

notes.text: Its identity is only "+10% speed": say what the charm lets you do.
